correctness.rationale: For idempotent e,f in T_n, B=e(X), A=f(X) have sizes r,s, intersection t; restrictions alpha=f|B, beta=e|A fix intersection C and free values outside A union B contribute (rs)^{n-r-s+t}. The full products are idempotent precisely when alpha beta alpha=alpha (for fe) and beta alpha beta=beta (for ef). For Y=alpha(B) size k containing C, select its k−t extra points from A\C, choose distinct representatives beta(Y) in B\C in (r−t)!/(r−k)! ways, assign remaining B\C elements to k image points in k^{r−k} ways. The remaining s−k beta inputs take any r values, except choices wholly in the k selected representatives which would also make ef idempotent, giving r^{s−k}−k^{s−k}. Multiply by choices of A,B and sum exact nonnegative t,k ranges. Every restriction/extension is uniquely counted, establishing all-n rank-refined formula. Independent full compositions for all idempotent pairs on n<=5 reproduced every coefficient and totals 0,0,6,204,5900, plus the symbolic formula gives n=6 total 190410; analytic bijection, not finite data, proves all n.

value.rationale: Skew idempotent multiplication is structurally natural in finite transformation semigroups. The first exact all-n joint-image-rank enumeration and concise rank-(2,2) formula refine mere existence/type theory, with a genuine combinatorial fiber-bijection rather than an arbitrary small-n table. The count is potentially reusable for random transformation semigroups and orbit statistics without requiring a downstream theorem.
residual_risks: Does not classify skew subtype multiplicities or simultaneous conjugation orbit counts.
